scope: Extend the unresolved 1961-06-21 Teachers' Organization Bill lineage forward into the military government's later education legislation, without assuming textual continuity.

findings.evidence: National Archives cabinet index page 144 lists no.1431 교육공무원법중 개정법률(제25회) and no.1433 교직단체법(제25회), both deliberated 1961-06-21; proposer fields are blank.

National Archives 국무회의 안건 목록집 I identifies 교육에 관한 임시특례법(안), proposer 문교부, BA0084271, item 20, 28 pages, production year 1961. National Archives subject registry identifies it as the 55th meeting item.
National Law Information Center records 교육에관한임시특례법 as Law No.708, promulgated and effective 1961-09-01. National Archives separately registers Gazette No.2946, BA0188689.

findings.claim: The June Teachers' Organization Bill became or was absorbed into Law No.708
findings.evidence: Chronology and subject overlap create a strong successor-policy lead, but no clause-level evidence yet connects the 1961-06-21 교직단체법 to the later 교육에 관한 임시특례법. The latter must not be described as a renamed or merged bill without original-text comparison.

findings.claim: Military-government education control became broader than a teachers-organization-only question
findings.evidence: Law No.708 displaced conflicting provisions of the Education Act and Education Public Officials Act; official and institutional histories document abolition/suspension of education autonomy, centralized appointments, university restructuring, and later implementing rules. This broadens the research line from union status to system-wide education governance.
